7500.grammar: masc, abstr, from na bhavati, neg
7500.commentary: (DNa) abhaven'assa na nandatī'ti tassa abhavena avuḍḍhiyā puttadārassa vā parijanassa vā tathārūpaṃ pārijuññaṃ disvā vā sutvā vā na nandati, anattamano hoti.

examples.text: catūhi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo. abhaven'assa na nandati, bhaven'assa nandati, avaṇṇaṃ bhaṇamānaṃ nivāreti, vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇamānaṃ pasaṃsati.
te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, abhavissa ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ na'y'idha jātassa bhūtassa katassa saṅkhatassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyetha
sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavaṃ'y'eva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, no ca kho bhikkhū ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, evam'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa ten'aṅgena.

7503.meaning1: (if) they would have been; those would be

examples.text: saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.

7509.grammar: prp of na bhāsati, neg, trans (+acc)
7509.meaning1: not speaking; not talking; not saying

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, pahoti rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro, aniñjamāno kāyena, abhāsamāno vācaṃ, satta rattin'divāni ek'antasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī viharitun'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

examples.text: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, sādhu sādhu, ānanda, sādhu kho tvaṃ, ānanda, kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekhaṃ pāṭipadaṃ abhāsī'ti.

sammā byākaramāno, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ byākareyya, idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃ, tassa me bhagavā dhammaṃ desesi, t'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhāsiṃ. taṃ te bhikkhū dhammaṃ sutvā akusalā vuṭṭhahiṃsu, kusale patiṭṭhahiṃsū'ti.

7513.meaning1: not said; not spoken; not preached (by)

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti. katame dve? yo ca abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenā'ti dīpeti, yo ca bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenā'ti dīpeti.

7514.commentary: (SNa) abhāsitvā'ti ettha a-kāro nipātamattaṃ, bhāsitvā'ti attho. abhāsayitvā'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato santike imā nibbejanīyā gāthāyo abhāsitvā tamhā ṭhānā apakkamma bhagavato avidūre pathaviyaṃ pallaṅkena nisīdi tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno kaṭṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhanto.

7522.grammar: pp of na bhāveti, neg, caus

7523.meaning1: undeveloped in body; uncultivated in body

examples.text: yassa kassaci, aggivessana, evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ uppannā'pi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannā'pi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa, evaṃ kho, aggivessana, abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca.
abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca? idha, aggivessana, assutavato puthujjanassa uppajjati sukhā vedanā. so sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno sukhasārāgī ca hoti sukhasārāgitañ'ca āpajjati.
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto app'ātumo appadukkhavihārī.
ye ca kho te, bho bhāradvāja, bhikkhū abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā, tesaṃ taṃ dukkaraṃ hoti.

pañcame abbhuyyāsī'ti parājaye garahappatto ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ suṇāthā'ti rattibhāge buddharakkhitena nāma vuḍḍhapabbajitena dhammarakkhitassa vuḍḍhapabbajitassa sace rājā imañ'ca upāyaṃ katvā gaccheyya, puna jineyyā'ti vuttajayakāraṇaṃ sutvā abhiuyyāsi.

ko sutvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇh'ābhijātiyo, tasmā hi attakāmena, mahattam'abhikaṅkhatā, saddhammo garukātabbo, saraṃ buddhāna'sāsanan'ti.

7536.commentary: (THa) vāc'ābhikaṅkhāmī'ti yathā ghammani ghammakāle uṇh'ābhitatto puriso kilanto tasito vāriṃ, evaṃ te vācaṃ abhikaṅkhāmi.

examples.text: paroparaṃ ariyadhammaṃ viditvā, mā mohayī jānam'anomavīriya, vāriṃ yathā ghammani ghammatatto, vāca-abhikaṅkhāmi sutaṃ pavassa.
pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ, vāca-abhikaṅkhāmi mahesi tuyhaṃ, tava sutvāna nigghosaṃ, sikkhe nibbānam'attano.

7538.synonym: ākaṅkhanta, ākaṅkhamāna, icchanta, icchamāna, nikāmayamāna, patthanaka, pihayamāna, pihenta

examples.text: nānājanā janapadehi saṅgatā, tava vīra vākyaṃ abhikaṅkhamānā, tesaṃ tuvaṃ sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
raṇaṃ karitvā kāmānaṃ, sītibhāva-abhikaṅkhinī, appamattā vihassāmi, sabbasaṃyojanakkhaye.

7546.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, yathā pāvuse kāle abbhāni valāhakāni verambhavāto nudati khipati nīharati, evam'eva me cittaṃ vivekapaṭisaññutā saññā abhikiranti vivekaṭṭhānaṃ'y'eva ākaḍḍhanti.

examples.text: yathā abbhāni verambho, vāto nudati pāvuse, saññā me abhikiranti, vivekapaṭisaññutā.

yathā vā pana, mahārāja, saṇha-sukhuma-aṇurajo anilabala-samāhato animittakatadiso yena vā tena vā abhikirati, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, sā papaṭikā pāsāṇasampahārena bhijjitvā animittakatadisā yena vā tena vā patamānā bhagavato pāde patitā.

7553.commentary: (NIDD2) evaṃ abhikkantadassāvin'ti evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ aggadassāviṃ seṭṭhadassāviṃ viseṭṭhadassāviṃ pāmokkhadassāviṃ uttamadassāviṃ paramadassāvinti, evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ. (DNa) abhikkantan'ti abhikantaṃ atiiṭṭhaṃ atimanāpaṃ atisundaran'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
ayaṃ me puggalo khamati imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. taṃ kissa hetu? abhikkantā h'esā, bho gotama, yadidaṃ upekkhā'ti.
so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ

7555.meaning1: advanced; progressed; moved on; (comm) ending; depletion
7555.commentary: (MNa) tatth'āyaṃ abhikkantasaddo khaya-sundar'ābhirūpa-abbhanumodanesu dissati. abhikkantā, bhante, ratti, nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo, ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho'ti-ādīsu hi khaye dissati.

examples.text: atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante paṭhame yāme, uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

7556.meaning1: more brilliant; more excellent; more wonderful (than)

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, potaliya, catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?
idam'pi kho, mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañ'ca paṇītatarañ'ca.

7557.commentary: (NIDD2) evaṃ abhikkantadassāvin'ti evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ aggadassāviṃ seṭṭhadassāviṃ viseṭṭhadassāviṃ pāmokkhadassāviṃ uttamadassāviṃ paramadassāvin'ti, evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ. 7560.commentary: (VINa) evañ'ca pana vatvā puna taṃ bhagavato dhammadesanaṃ abbhanumodamāno abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotamā'ti'ādim'āha. (MNa) atha vā abhikkantan'ti abhikantaṃ. atiiṭṭhaṃ atimanāpaṃ, atisundaran'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

7561.commentary: (MNa) tena abhikkantāya rattiyā'ti parikkhīṇāya rattiyāti vuttaṃ hoti. tatth'āyaṃ devaputto majjhimayāmasamanantare āgato'ti veditabbo.

7562.commentary: (MNa) abhikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo'ti yasmiñ'hi samaye māraṇ'antikā vedanā uppajjati, uparivāte jalit'aggi viya hoti, yāva usmā na pariyādiyati, tāva mahatā'pi upakkamena na sakkā vūpasametuṃ, usmāya pana pariyādinnāya vūpasammati.

examples.text: kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo'ti?
na me, āvuso sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā n'eva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati tatth'eva khīlaṭṭhāyī ṭhito hoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sattamo assadoso.

tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, jegucchismiṃ hoti, so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, sato'va abhikkamāmi, sato'va paṭikkamāmi, yāva udakabindumhi'pi me dayā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, m'āhaṃ khuddake pāṇe visamagate saṅghātaṃ āpādesin'ti.

7564.meaning1: (of illness) is increasing; is getting worse

upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantañ'ca nandiyaṃ āyasmantañ'ca kimilaṃ etadavoca, abhikkamatha-āyasmanto, abhikkamatha-āyasmanto, satthā no bhagavā anuppatto'ti

7567.meaning1: going forward; proceeding; coming; coming out; approaching

examples.text: m'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā. kathañ'hi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto, sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati, n'atthi attakāro, n'atthi parakāro'ti!
so abhikkamanto paṭikkamanto bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādeti. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto kaṃ vipākaṃ paññapetī'ti?

7568.meaning1: going and coming; going forward and coming back

examples.text: hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.

7569.meaning1: obediently going forward and coming back

examples.text: yato kho, aggivessana, āraññako nāgo hatthidamakassa abhikkama-paṭikkama-vacanakaro hoti ovādappaṭikaro, tam'enaṃ hatthidamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti, uṭṭhaha, bho, nisīda, bho'ti.

7571.meaning1: should be proceeded with; should be walked forward

examples.text: tam'enaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārino ovadanti anusāsanti, evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban'ti.
na me, āvuso sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.

7573.meaning1: came out; came forward; presented oneself

examples.text: iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.

ko nu kho, bhante, vammiko, kā rattiṃ dhūmāyanā, kā divā pajjalanā, ko brāhmaṇo, ko sumedho, kiṃ satthaṃ, kiṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ, kā laṅgī, kā uddhumāyikā, ko dvidhāpatho, kiṃ caṅgavāraṃ, ko kummo, kā asisūnā, kā maṃsapesi, ko nāgo'ti?
satthan'ti kho, bhikkhu, ariyāy'etaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ. abhikkhaṇan'ti kho, bhikkhu, vīriy'ārambhass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

7576.commentary: (MNa) ukkhipa laṅgiṃ abhikkhaṇa sumedhā'ti tāta, paṇḍita, laṅgī nāma rattiṃ dhūmāyati divā pajjalati. ukkhipeta paraṃ parato khaṇāti.

examples.text: bhikkhu bhikkhu, ayaṃ vammiko rattiṃ dhūmāyati, divā pajjalati. brāhmaṇo evam'āha, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti. abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa laṅgiṃ. laṅgī, bhadante'ti.
bhikkhu bhikkhu, ayaṃ vammiko rattiṃ dhūmāyati, divā pajjalati. brāhmaṇo evam'āha, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti. abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa laṅgiṃ. laṅgī, bhadante'ti.

7579.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of abhikkhaṇa

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṃkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṃkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.

7583.meaning1: (of a monastery) without resident monks; not containing monastics
7583.construction:
na > a + √bhikkh + u + ka
abhikkhu + ka
7583.commentary: (VINa) abhikkhuko āvāso'ti suññavihāro, yattha eko'pi bhikkhu n'atthi, tattha vās'atthāya na gantabbaṃ.

examples.text: na bhikkhuniyā abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ vasitabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.

7587.commentary: (THIa) abhigajjant'iva mālut'eritā'ti vātena sañcalitā abhigajjant'iva abhitthanitā viya tiṭṭhanti.

examples.text: kusumitasikharā ca pādapā, abhigajjant'iva mālut'eritā, kā tuyhaṃ rati bhavissati, yadi ekā vanam'ogahissasi.
sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

7591.meaning1: roaring; thundering; raising a noise; crying out

examples.text: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosatthanita-abhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosatthanita-abhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

7592.meaning2: having gone near; having approached; having arrived (at)

examples.text: mahaddhanā mahābhogā, raṭṭhavanto'pi khattiyā, aññam'añña-abhigijjhanti, kāmesu analaṅ'katā.
gāthā-abhigītaṃ me abhojaneyyaṃ, sampassataṃ brāhmaṇa n'esa dhammo, gāthā-abhigītaṃ panudanti buddhā, dhamme satī brāhmaṇa vutti'r'esā.
sattadhā me phale muddhā, jīvanto na sukhaṃ labhe, buddhagāthā-abhigīto'mhi, no ce muñceyya candiman'ti.
bhasmapuṭan'ti chārikābhaṇḍikaṃ. gārayhaṃ bhasmapuṭan'ti garahitabba-chārikāpuṭena matthake abhighāt'ārahaṃ.
